import ctypes, os, select, sys, time

def put(path, text):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path) or ".", exist_ok=True)
    tmp = path + ".tmp"
    with open(tmp, "wb") as f:
        f.write(text if isinstance(text, bytes) else text.encode())
    os.rename(tmp, path)

def stat_line(pid, comm, state, ppid, utime, stime, nice, start, vsize, rss):
    # proc(5) /proc/PID/stat fields 1..24 followed by zero fields up to 52
    f = [str(pid), "(%s)" % comm, state, str(ppid), "1", "1", "0", "-1", "4194560", "0", "0", "0", "0",
         str(utime), str(stime), "0", "0", "20", str(nice), "1", "0", str(start), str(vsize), str(rss)]
    f += ["0"] * (52 - len(f))
    return " ".join(f) + "\n"

# pid, comm, cmdline bytes, uid, state, (utime, stime) at sample 1, at sample 2, rss pages
MAIN = [
    (100, "alpha",   b"alpha\0--run\0",   0,    "R", (100, 50), (600, 50),  500),
    (200, "beta",    b"beta\0",           0,    "S", (150, 50), (350, 100), 2000),
    (300, "gamma",   b"gamma\0-v\0x\0",   4242, "S", (150, 50), (350, 100), 2000),
    (400, "delta",   b"",                 0,    "S", (60, 30),  (60, 30),   100),
    (500, "epsilon", b"epsilon\0a\0b\0",  4242, "D", (60, 30),  (60, 30),   100),
]
CPU1 = "cpu  4000 0 2000 4000 0 0 0 0 0 0\ncpu0 4000 0 2000 4000 0 0 0 0 0 0\nintr 0\n"
CPU2 = "cpu  4300 0 2200 4500 0 0 0 0 0 0\ncpu0 4300 0 2200 4500 0 0 0 0 0 0\nintr 0\n"
MEM = ("MemTotal:        8000000 kB\nMemFree:         1000000 kB\nMemAvailable:    5000000 kB\nBuffers:           10000 kB\n"
       "SwapTotal:       1000000 kB\nSwapFree:         750000 kB\n")
LOAD = "0.52 0.41 0.30 2/100 12345\n"

def common(d):
    put(d + "/meminfo", MEM)
    put(d + "/loadavg", LOAD)
    put(d + "/uptime", "93784.12 180000.00\n")

def write_proc(d, pid, comm, cmd, uid, state, ut, rss, status=True):
    put("%s/%d/stat" % (d, pid), stat_line(pid, comm, state, 1, ut[0], ut[1], 0, 1000 + pid, 4096 * 1000, rss))
    if status:
        put("%s/%d/status" % (d, pid), "Name:\t%s\nUmask:\t0022\nState:\t%s\nUid:\t%d\t%d\t%d\t%d\nGid:\t0\t0\t0\t0\n" % (comm, state, uid, uid, uid, uid))
    put("%s/%d/cmdline" % (d, pid), cmd)

def make(d, scen):
    if os.path.exists("watch.ready"):
        os.unlink("watch.ready")
    os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
    common(d)
    if scen == "main":
        put(d + "/stat", CPU1)
        for pid, comm, cmd, uid, st, a, b, rss in MAIN:
            write_proc(d, pid, comm, cmd, uid, st, a, rss)
    elif scen == "malformed":
        put(d + "/stat", CPU1)
        write_proc(d, 100, "plain", b"plain\0arg\0", 0, "S", (10, 10), 40)
        write_proc(d, 110, "nostatus", b"nostatus\0", 0, "S", (10, 10), 41, status=False)
        put("%s/%d/status" % (d, 120), "garbage without any uid line\n\x00\xff\n")
        put("%s/%d/stat" % (d, 120), stat_line(120, "badstatus", "S", 1, 10, 10, 0, 1120, 4096 * 1000, 42))
        put("%s/%d/cmdline" % (d, 120), b"badstatus\0")
        write_proc(d, 130, "emptycmd", b"", 0, "S", (10, 10), 43)
        write_proc(d, 150, "nocmdfile", b"x", 0, "S", (10, 10), 45)
        os.unlink(d + "/150/cmdline")
        write_proc(d, 160, "paren)name (x", b"paren\0", 0, "S", (10, 10), 46)
        write_proc(d, 170, "truncated", b"truncated\0", 0, "S", (10, 10), 47)
        put(d + "/170/stat", "170 (truncated) S 1 1 1\n")
        write_proc(d, 180, "empty", b"empty\0", 0, "S", (10, 10), 48)
        put(d + "/180/stat", "")
        write_proc(d, 190, "alpha", b"tail\0", 0, "R", (10, 10), 49)
    elif scen == "empty":
        put(d + "/stat", CPU1)

def watch(d):
    libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
    fd = libc.inotify_init1(os.O_NONBLOCK)
    libc.inotify_add_watch(fd, d.encode(), 0x20)   # IN_OPEN on entries of the fixture root
    put("watch.ready", "1")
    r, _, _ = select.select([fd], [], [], 8)
    if not r:
        sys.exit("watcher: top never opened the fixture")
    time.sleep(0.1)                                 # the first sample has long finished; the second starts at ~200 ms
    put(d + "/stat", CPU2)
    for pid, comm, cmd, uid, st, a, b, rss in MAIN:
        put("%s/%d/stat" % (d, pid), stat_line(pid, comm, st, 1, b[0], b[1], 0, 1000 + pid, 4096 * 1000, rss))

    import json
    d = {}
    base = "realproc/%s/fd" % pid
    for n in sorted(os.listdir(base), key=int):
        p = base + "/" + n
        try:
            s = os.stat(p)
            d[n] = [os.readlink(p), s.st_dev, s.st_ino]
        except OSError as e:
            d[n] = [os.readlink(p) if os.path.islink(p) else "?", str(e)]
    open(out, "w").write(json.dumps(d, sort_keys=True))

def fdcmp(a, b):
    import json
    x, y = json.load(open(a)), json.load(open(b))
    print("identical" if x == y else "differ:%s" % sorted(set(map(str, x.items())) ^ set(map(str, y.items()))))

elif cmd == "watch": watch(a[0])
elif cmd == "fds": fds(a[0], a[1])
elif cmd == "fdcmp": fdcmp(a[0], a[1])
